headline: CHICKEN 🐔 SHOP DATE 🍽️ Is CLOSING 🛑 Its DOORS 🚪 After A DECADE 📆
text:
AMELIA 🧑‍🦰 DIMOLDENBERG 🗣️ has been the HOST 🍗 of CHICKEN 🐔 SHOP DATE 🍽️ since TWENTY 🕰️ FOURTEEN 📅 and now the DEADPAN 😐 QUEEN 👑 is SLAMMING 🚪 the doors shut after MORE 🔢 than a DECADE ⏳ of RAISING 🔥 eyebrows with her OFF 🌀 THE 🌀 WALL 🧱 questions ❓ and those ICONIC 🤫 silences that left 🍆 celebs squirming in their seats 🪑!! The presenter known for turning every interview into a WEIRD 😵‍💫 first date has dropped the bomb 💣 on INSTAGRAM 📸 telling fans that ALL 🥰 good dates must eventually come to an end 🌅 so expect a few FINAL 🔥 dates before the whole thing gets wrapped up like a leftover 🍗 box!!

TO 🫶 ME the show is my very OWN 📽️ rom-com 💕 and I have LOVED ❤️ creating so many STORIES 📖 for you to watch she WROTE ✍️ while dropping the news that she's GRATEFUL 🙌 to everyone who followed this journey and found some JOY 😂 in these episodes!! I never thought I'd STOP 🛑 CHICKEN 🐔 SHOP DATE 🍽️ I thought maybe it would be a part of me FOREVER ♾️ and in some way it always WILL 🧠 be but I feel like it's now TIME ⏰ to move on from this ADVENTURE 🗺️ and on to a new one after interviewing absolute UNIT 🏋️‍♂️ stars like CYNTHIA 🧚‍♀️ ERIVO and even the BEATLES 🎸 legend PAUL 🍎 MCCARTNEY!!

JUST 🗓️ months ago AMELIA 🧑‍🦰 insisted she had ZERO 🚫 plans to end her BABY 👶 and said she planned to carry on until she met her ONE ❤️ true love but now the CANADIAN 🇨🇦 DREAM ☁️ GUEST 🕺 DRAKE might be sliding into one of those LAST 🏁 final dates as fans are already SPECULATING 🕵️ like crazy under the ANNOUNCEMENT 📢 post!! Her most recent episodes featured the MUSIC 🎵 heavyweight PAUL 🍎 MCCARTNEY the SWEDISH 🇸🇪 pop princess ZARA 🧁 LARSSON and that TOWERING 🗼 US host CONAN 🍊 O'BRIEN who all got the full awkward date TREATMENT 🍴!!

THOUSANDS 🧮 of supportive comments flooded in with RADIO 📻 one presenter JAMIE 🦷 LAING calling her THE 🐐 GOAT while author ELIZABETH 📖 DAY praised knowing WHEN ⏰ to stop and leaving on such a HIGH 🏔️ after shaping the culture as the quintessential POWER 💪 move!! Rapper TINIE 🐰 TEMPAH simply wrote SMASHED 🥊 IT and the outpouring made it clear that this CHICKEN 🍗 SHOP DATE 🍽️ run has been nothing short of LEGENDARY 🏆 for the UK content scene!!

AMELIA 🧑‍🦰 previously told the BBC how CHICKEN 🐔 SHOP DATE 🍽️ grew out of a series of interviews with GRIME 🎤 artists she conducted as a teenager for that culture magazine called THE ✂️ CUT and she started the whole thing as part of a YOUTH 🧒 club where the magazine the connections and the mentoring set her up for the career she has TODAY 🏗️!! Entertainment journalist and superfan MEGAN 🐂 BULL says the show's original anti-interview format helped it BLAST 🚀 off because AMELIA 🧑‍🦰 has such a good way of putting celebrities at EASE 🛋️ by using this totally untraditional vibe that somehow makes everyone SPILL 🗣️ their secrets!!

IT'S 📈 led to success way beyond YOUTUBE 📺 from red carpets to the big screen and the TWENTY 🕹️ EIGHT year old has even scored a cameo in DEVIL 😈 WEARS 👠 PRADA 2 which proves these web shows can expand into something bigger than anyone imagined!! She has been a vocal supporter of training programmes and apprenticeships to help young people into employment yet success didn't come overnight as she spent YEARS 🕰️ persuading publicists managers and talent to come on the show back when social media wasn't seen as the best place to promote an album or film!! CHICKEN 🐔 SHOP DATE 🍽️ now ranks alongside GRAHAM 🧔 NORTON or BBC RADIO 📻 1 for celebrities seeking that sweet media cut through and fans are already down bad wondering what this absolute UNIT 🏗️ will cook up next on her fresh adventure!!
